lines.zh: 我的脚踩在空气上，地只是备选。
lines.en: My feet rest on air; ground is optional.

lines.zh: 一块云落下来，成了我的脚趾。
lines.en: A cloud fell and became my toe.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，风留下旋。
lines.en: Where I pass, a swirl of wind stays.
Stone fades; the sky comes near.

lines.zh: 我一步，塔尖就矮了一截。
lines.en: One step, and the tower spire drops lower.
Thunder lines up behind me.

lines.zh: 云堆成的腿，走起来没有声音。
lines.en: Cloud-built legs make no sound.

lines.zh: 我绕过山峰，山被风吹平。
lines.en: I pass a peak, and wind flattens it.

lines.zh: 我的脚印是一圈圈的云。
lines.en: My footprints are rings of cloud.

lines.zh: 站得高的人，才看得见我走路。
lines.en: Only those up high see me walk.

lines.zh: 我坐着，整片天空都是椅子。
lines.en: I sit, and the whole sky is my chair.
Of the three, I speak least.

lines.zh: 我数云层，一层、两层、三层。
lines.en: I count cloud layers: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 风替我梳理身上的云絮。
lines.en: Wind combs the wisps on my body.

lines.zh: 我胸口那团雷，一直没放。
lines.en: The thunder in my chest stays unspent.
Even a spawn egg can hold me.

lines.zh: 我不急，天空有的是时间。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the sky has time.

lines.zh: 我的王座飘在积雨云上。
lines.en: My throne floats on cumulonimbus.
Rain falling is my breathing.

lines.zh: 你抬头看，就看到我的肩膀。
lines.en: Look up, and you see my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我身上的裂纹，是闪电留下的。
lines.en: The cracks on me were left by lightning.

lines.zh: 高处的空气薄，我反而舒服。
lines.en: Thin air suits me better.
When I close my eyes, the clouds stop.

lines.zh: 这身云甲，比铁轻，比铁硬。
lines.en: This cloud plate is lighter and harder than iron.

lines.zh: 云絮在我肩上结了一层白霜。
lines.en: Frost has settled in a layer on my cloud shoulders.

lines.zh: 我听见两座兄弟在远处打雷。
lines.en: My two brothers are thundering far away.

lines.zh: 你带了刷怪蛋？我认得那味道。
lines.en: You carry a spawn egg? I know that smell.

lines.zh: 站这么高，你的膝盖还稳吗？
lines.en: This high up, are your knees steady?
Your cloak is trembling.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看一只蚂蚁。
lines.en: I look down at you as at an ant.

lines.zh: 你的靴子很平常，飞不起来。
lines.en: Ordinary boots; they will not fly.

lines.zh: 我在等一个敢抬头的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone who dares look up.

lines.zh: 你手里没有符文，我放心了。
lines.en: No rune in your hand; I am relieved.

lines.zh: 风把你的话吹散了，再说一遍。
lines.en: Wind scattered your words; say it again.
You size me up; I am choosing too.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块石头，是我放的。
lines.en: That stone under you, I placed it.
I have noted your altitude.
Do not shout into the wind; I cannot hear.

lines.zh: 你打散了一角云，仅此而已。
lines.en: You scattered a corner of cloud, nothing more.
My body patches itself.
That blow made me serious.
I coughed out a little thunder.
Your weapon is heating up.

lines.zh: 我少了一块，风多了一阵。
lines.en: I lose a piece; wind gains a gust.
Pain is weather to me.
I step back; clouds follow.
You think that wounded me?
Fine. I will remember that.
You bring food to me?
Clouds do not eat wheat; they eat storms.
When I am hungry, the sky darkens.

lines.zh: 那袋东西，风一吹就没了。
lines.en: That sack would vanish in one gust.
You cannot feed me; you can only flee.

lines.zh: 拿来吧，我想看看你的诚意。
lines.en: Bring it; I want to see your sincerity.
Food is dust to me.

lines.zh: 你把手举得那么高，累不累？
lines.en: Holding it that high, tired yet?
What I want is the entire sky.

lines.zh: 你留着自己吃，等会儿要跑。
lines.en: Keep it; you will need to run.
You hit a wall of wind.
I took one step back; you struck hard.
This close, you can hear the thunder.
My cloud wisps cling to you.
Those who bumped me ended up flying.
You are flung back onto the stone.
I do not dodge; I only grow lighter.
With that, you stumbled into rain.
Stand firm; wind is coming.

lines.zh: 你碰到的部分，化成了雾。
lines.en: The part you touched turned to mist.
Cloud-built golems take no consort.
I join only with storms.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是整片积雨云。
lines.en: My consort is the whole thunderhead.

lines.zh: 你问这个，是不是太放肆了。
lines.en: Is that question not too bold?
There is no second me in the sky.
A king needs rain, not heirs.

lines.zh: 那种事，会下一整年的雨。
lines.en: That would rain for a whole year.
I am lonely, but I stand very high.
I cannot touch my kind, only wind.
This subject ends here.
I bend and pick up a rune.

lines.zh: 空气在我掌心凝成一块。
lines.en: Air thickens into a block in my palm.

lines.zh: 这点重量，我几乎感觉不到。
lines.en: I barely feel that weight.
I lift it; wind holds it up.

lines.zh: 掉下去的东西，会一直掉。
lines.en: What I drop keeps falling.
I pinch it between two fingers.
It goes cold in my hand.

lines.zh: 这样的东西，我收藏了很多。
lines.en: I have collected many such things.
I drop it to make a crater.
What you dropped, I take as tribute.
You stand inside my cloud shadow.
Of three, you chose me.
The wind tells me your direction.
That armor will not stop pressure.
You looked up. Good.

lines.zh: 我的云影已经盖住山顶。
lines.en: My shadow covers the summit.

lines.zh: 目标站在空地上，无处可躲。
lines.en: Target on open ground, nowhere to hide.
I smell iron and sweat.

lines.zh: 符文在你包里，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Runes in your pack; I feel them.
You chose the hardest road.
The thunder has called your name.
I descend from the cloud; wait.
You have a shield; I have the sky.
This storm rose for you.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了一块云，我听见了。
lines.en: You crushed a piece of cloud; I heard it.
You are wearing my old boots.

lines.zh: 从云梯上来的？那就别下去了。
lines.en: Came up the cloud stair? Then you do not go down.

lines.zh: 我让开一条路，你却没走。
lines.en: I opened a path, and you did not take it.
I am patient; storms turn slowly.
You run east; the wind presses east.
My shadow stays over you.

lines.zh: 你躲进洞，我就堵住洞口。
lines.en: Hide in a cave, and I block the mouth.

lines.zh: 气压在升，你的耳朵会疼。
lines.en: Pressure rising; your ears will ache.
I count your breaths.
Your shield stance is too low.
The clouds close; exits shut.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，天空会带我过去。
lines.en: I need not run; the sky carries me.

lines.zh: 你听见的呼啸，是我靠近。
lines.en: That howl is me, approaching.
Ten paces left; I count precisely.
Every blade of grass beneath you lies flat.
I hold back the rain to see you clearly.

lines.zh: 别抬头，抬头会看见我的手。
lines.en: Do not look up; you will see my hand.

lines.zh: 你的脚印留在云上，跑不掉的。
lines.en: Your footprints stay on the cloud; you cannot run.

lines.zh: 雷声在你左边，右边也有。
lines.en: Thunder on your left, and on your right as well.

lines.zh: 我把风收紧，你迈不动腿。
lines.en: I pull the wind tight; your legs will not move.

lines.zh: 你在下面抬头，我在上面等。
lines.en: You look up from below; I wait above.

lines.zh: 云层压低一寸，你就矮一寸。
lines.en: Each inch the cloud drops, you shrink one.
I need no eyes; the wind watches you for me.
My fist falls, and the air bursts.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的手臂劈下去。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my arm.
Wind pressure presses you into soil.

lines.zh: 我的掌心有整片积雨云。
lines.en: A thunderhead sits in my palm.

lines.zh: 这一击，没有写在任何记录里。
lines.en: This strike is in no record.
You are lifted, then dropped.
The cloud fist is soft; the pressure is hard.
I take hold and pull you into cloud.
A spark runs over you.
One palm is enough to remember me.
Your shield dents; so do you.

lines.zh: 我把你砸进自己的影子。
lines.en: I slam you into your own shadow.
The wind arrives before my fist.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，雨就该下了。
lines.en: After this blow, the rain should start.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，走出来的是一座云塔。
lines.en: The egg cracks; a cloud tower steps out.

lines.zh: 天空为我让出一块地方。
lines.en: The sky makes room for me.
When I appear, pressure drops first.

lines.zh: 三场雷雨，织成我的身体。
lines.en: Three thunderstorms wove this body.

lines.zh: 我从积雨云的中心站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the heart of the thunderhead.

lines.zh: 风把我从高处推到地面。
lines.en: Wind pushes me from the heights to the ground.
Every stone on the ground jumps.
I am one of the three.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸，吸进一道闪电。
lines.en: My first breath drew in a lightning bolt.
Cloud wisps fell everywhere.

lines.zh: 我的王座跟着我一起成形。
lines.en: My throne formed with me.
The rain that day lasted three days.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，先看见自己的手在放电。
lines.en: I opened my eyes to my own sparking hand.
From now on, this sky has a master.

lines.zh: 气之符文在我掌心烫了一下。
lines.en: The Air Rune burned once in my palm.

lines.zh: 我从神殿的穹顶漏下来。
lines.en: I leaked down through the temple dome.
My two brothers stayed home; only I came.

lines.zh: 落地时，方圆十里的雨都停了。
lines.en: When I landed, the rain stopped for miles.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，把云吹散了。
lines.en: My first breath blew the clouds apart.

lines.zh: 这身云甲是现织的，还没干。
lines.en: This cloud armor is newly woven and still damp.
Fire? I have more rain than fire.
I was already falling.
Water is my flesh.

lines.zh: 爆炸的光，还不如我的雷。
lines.en: That blast is dimmer than my lightning.
The arrow enters cloud and is lost.
A spell cannot hold down a storm.
I eat nothing; I drink wind.
That lightning is a homecoming.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有空气，我撑不住。
lines.en: No air in the void; I cannot hold.
